name: KromiumConsoleMessage
summary: A message logged to the browser's JavaScript developer console.
declaration:
data class KromiumConsoleMessage(
    val level: KromiumConsoleMessageLevel,
    val message: String,
    val source: String = "",
    val line: Int = 0
)

constructors.signature: KromiumConsoleMessage(level: KromiumConsoleMessageLevel, message: String, source: String = "", line: Int = 0)

parameters.name: level
parameters.description: The severity level of the console message.

parameters.name: message
parameters.description: The text content of the message.

parameters.name: source
parameters.description: The URL or script origin that emitted the message.

parameters.name: line
parameters.description: The line number in the source file where the message was emitted (1-based), or 0 if unknown.
